data.title: Norwegian, Finnish leaders hold ‘frank’ talks with Putin
data.description: HELSINKI - The Finnish president and Norwegian prime minister held a “frank and substantive” discussion with Russian President Vladimir Putin on Tuesday about efforts to end the war in Ukraine, the Nordic leaders said.

data.title: Border troops seize millions of meth pills after armed clash
data.description: Army troops seized about four million methamphetamine pills following a skirmish with smugglers near the Myanmar border in Mae Sai district of Chiang Rai province.

data.title: Dutch broadcaster pulls out of Eurovision over Israel 'sensitivities'
data.description: THE HAGUE - The Netherlands will not participate in next year's Eurovision Song Contest, its public broadcaster NPO said on Tuesday, citing "sensitivities" over Israel's participation.

data.title: Celebrating 30 Years of Pokémon
data.description: Bangkok, 26 October 2026 - The Pokémon Company (headquartered in Minato-ku, Tokyo; CEO Tsunekazu Ishihara) today announced a series of special initiatives planned for Thailand in celebration of the Pokémon 30th Anniversary at a press conference held at centralwOrld in Bangkok. The announcement highlighted a range of upcoming events and experiences designed to bring the world of Pokémon closer to fans across Thailand.

data.title: Six arrest warrants issued in VGI share ownership concealment case
data.description: Three linked investors allegedly held over 25% of VGI’s voting rights without reporting their combined holdings or making a tender offer for all securities.

data.title: Japan sets 'second capital' criteria, 4 prefectures qualify
data.description: The Japanese government approved an ordinance on Tuesday setting requirements for designation as a "second capital" to back up Tokyo in disasters and promote decentralisation, with Osaka and three other prefectures qualifying.

data.title: Rescued red panda transferred to Khao Kheow Open Zoo
data.description: A female red panda rescued from suspected international wildlife traffickers has been transferred to the Khao Kheow Open Zoo in Chon Buri for medical assessment and rehabilitation.

data.title: Villagers' apology for felled trees at royal memorial not enough
data.description: CHIANG MAI - Villagers on Doi Pui mountain have apologised for allowing volunteers to "clean up" a memorial for the late King Bhumibul Adulyadej, resulting in 15 beautiful big trees being cut down.

data.title: Reparations calls overshadow King Charles’ Caribbean trip
data.description: LONDON - King Charles III begins a delicate tour of the Caribbean on Tuesday, overshadowed by calls to apologise and pay reparations for the slave trade, which he has called the “darkest days” of British history.

data.title: BLS Surgery Center named Face Lifting Centre of the Year for 2nd year
data.description: BLS Surgery Center, a specialised plastic surgery centre led by qualified plastic surgeons, has again strengthened its reputation in facelift surgery in the Asia-Pacific region by receiving the prestigious “Face Lifting Centre of the Year in Thailand” award for a second consecutive year. The achievement reflects the centre's commitment to advancing surgical standards under its guiding philosophy of “Beauty with Safety.” By combining individualised surgical planning, meticulous attention to detail and a strong emphasis on patient safety at every stage of care, BLS Surgery Center strives to deliver natural-looking, harmonious and long-lasting facelift results tailored to each patient’s facial anatomy and aesthetic goals.

data.title: Chayapa Chutrakul Explores Luxury Branding and Female Entrepreneurship at Asia Summit
data.description: Chayapa "Pink" Chutrakul, founder and executive director of The Bureau of Wonders, a leading luxury communications and branding agency, joined international entrepreneurs and industry leaders at the Business of Luxury Summit Asia Edition 2026, hosted by Nikkei and the Financial Times at Capella Bangkok on Oct 19–20. The summit brought together global perspectives on entrepreneurship, leadership and the evolving luxury landscape.

data.title: Mbappe dropped by Chinese brands for 'offending national sentiments'
data.description: BEIJING — Kylian Mbappe was dropped Tuesday by two major brands in China after a video circulated online in which the French football superstar apparently joked about former leader Mao Zedong.

data.title: DNA tests expose 24 more Chinese children with fake Thai fathers
data.description: DNA tests have identified 24 more Chinese-born children whose Thai birth certificates wrongfully list unrelated Thai men as their fathers.

data.title: Three Women Leaders on How AI Is Transforming Business
data.description: Knowing what you want and making the most of opportunities when they arise is a belief shared by three women leaders navigating a world transformed by AI: Monsinee Nakapanant, Co-president of Ascend Money; Natchachanok Na Takuathung, Chief Executive Officer, CP Fresh Co., Ltd.; and Saranee Sanguanruang (Faunglada), Founder and Chief Executive Officer, Soul First Co., Ltd. They shared their experiences at “WOMEN WHO BUILD WHAT’S NEXT: Leading Innovation, Shaping Inclusive Growth”, a panel discussion held during CP Innovation Exposition 2026, CP Group’s ninth innovation exposition, at True Digital Park.

data.title: Opposition distances itself from bogus B7m tea-money payment
data.description: The credibility of the opposition’s coming no-confidence debate will be judged by the evidence presented during the parliamentary proceedings, not by a social media post later proven to contain false information, opposition chief whip Parit Wacharasindhu said on Tuesday.

data.title: CC DOUBLE O teams up with the NBA for ‘GAME OF LAYERS’ collection
data.description: CC DOUBLE O today (Oct 26, 2026) announced the launch of a new collection of officially licensed products from the National Basketball Association (NBA) coinciding with the start of the 2026-2027 NBA season. Inspired by basketball culture, the NBA Collection by CC Double O is built around the “GAME OF LAYERS” concept, featuring a casual look and feel that allows fans to mix, match and layer pieces representing 16 teams, including the Boston Celtics, Chicago Bulls, Golden State Warriors, Los Angeles Lakers, New York Knicks and San Antonio Spurs .

data.title: King, Queen set to see requiem performance
data.description: Their Majesties the King and Queen will preside over and attend the premiere of "A Royal Requiem: Music in Memory and Prayers" on Nov 18 at Assumption Cathedral in Bangkok, an event organised by the Apostolic Nunciature of the Holy See in Thailand and the Catholic Bishops' Conference of Thailand (CBCT).

data.title: Myanmar refugee in Denmark demands justice over junta war crimes
data.description: A Myanmar citizen living in Denmark on Monday filed a complaint with Danish authorities against the country’s ruling military junta for alleged war crimes committed against minorities.

data.title: US singer Chris Brown avoids jail over London nightclub brawl
data.description: LONDON - American singer Chris Brown avoided jail when sentenced by a UK court on Monday after pleading guilty to a public order offence during a 2023 brawl at a London nightclub.

data.title: Hylife Group supports Busan festival for a second year
data.description: BUSAN, South Korea: Hylife Group continues its support for the creative industry for the second consecutive year at the 31st Busan International Film Festival 2026 through the Hylife Vision Award. The award recognizes outstanding cinematic works that demonstrate exceptional creativity and vision, while supporting the potential of artists and creative talents and providing opportunities for distinctive works to reach international audiences.

data.title: NBA inks deal with Kalshi and Polymarket, citing safeguards
data.description: LOS ANGELES — The National Basketball Association (NBA) on Monday announced commercial partnerships with Kalshi and Polymarket that the basketball league said will help safeguard against illegal activity on the wildly popular online prediction markets.

data.title: Israel to give verdict on Netanyahu in pivotal election
data.description: JERUSALEM - A deeply divided Israel will head to the polls on Tuesday for the first time since Hamas's attack on Oct 7, 2023, with voters delivering their verdict on veteran Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and the country's rightward drift.

data.title: In Israel, Eisenkot tries quiet appeal to oust Netanyahu
data.description: JERUSALEM - Gadi Eisenkot, the man who could unseat Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, almost always dresses in black, speaks halting English and tends to respond in interviews with bullet-point lists, a reflection of the military culture that shaped him.

data.title: New Zealand ex-PM Ardern to teach leadership in Sydney
data.description: SYDNEY — Former New Zealand prime minister Jacinda Ardern will teach students about "empathetic leadership" after being hired for a new job at the University of Sydney.
